verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms provides APIs for legal entities, balance accounts, split transactions, and managed/custom payouts that a developer can wrap in their own branded UI (docs-6, docs-9, docs-12, docs-21, docs-23), and explicitly markets 'offer payments under your own brand embedded into your software' (docs-28, docs-29). However, the evidence shows only build-your-own-UI-via-API or Adyen-hosted onboarding pages — no prebuilt white-label UI components/widgets for balances, payouts, or transaction history are documented, and there's no explicit transaction-history API/report component beyond split-transaction instructions and reconciliation reports. Missing for 10: dedicated transaction-history API/endpoint, prebuilt embeddable UI components (vs. API-only build-your-own), and independent/hands-on confirmation of white-labeling in production.
